policy.principle: A transaction may temporarily own a rollback state. The repository never does. Git owns history; the incident system owns evidence; secret material expires.
policy.secret_handling: size, digest and structural counts only; never content, never a value, never an identifying prefix
policy.unclassified_handling: never deleted; requires a deliberate decision
